s1.syndrome_frame: Palpitations with chest pain and lightheadedness
salient_findings: Narrow QRS regular tachycardia triggering a nonsustained phase of wide complex irregular tachycardia
Wide complex configuration until spontaneous termination
Tachycardia with a cycle length of 250 ms
key_facts: Chest pain and lightheadedness associated with palpitations
No family history of sudden cardiac death
Treadmill Stress Test was negative for exercise-induced myocardial ischemia or arrhythmias

raw.rationale: The patient's smartwatch recording showed a narrow QRS regular tachycardia triggering a nonsustained phase of wide complex irregular tachycardia, which is consistent with supraventricular tachycardia with aberrancy. The electrophysiology study also revealed tachycardia with a cycle length of 250 ms, which supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Wolff-Parkinson-White Syndrome
rejected.why: No evidence of pre-excitation or an accessory pathway on the initial ECG
